problem: If ${z}_{1}=5-2\text{i}$ and ${z}_{2}=3\text{i}$, then ${z}_{1}$ divided by ${z}_{2}$ equals

feedback.worked_solution:
The denominator is $5-3\text{i}$ and its conjugate is $5+3\text{i}.$ We multiply both the numerator and the denominator by $5+3\text{i},$ so that the denominator turns into a real number:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\frac{2}{5-3\text{i}} & =\frac{2}{5-3\text{i}}\cdot \frac{5+3\text{i}}{5+3\text{i}} \\  & =\frac{10+6\text{i}}{25+15\text{i}-15\text{i}-9{\text{i}}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{10+6\text{i}}{25-9{\text{i}}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{10+6\text{i}}{25-(9)(-1)} \\  & =\frac{10+6\text{i}}{25+9} \\  & =\frac{10+6\text{i}}{34}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now that the denominator is a real number, we can write the complex number in the form $a+b\text{i}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}\frac{10+6\text{i}}{34}=\frac{10}{34}+\frac{6}{34}\text{i}=\frac{5}{17}+\frac{3}{17}\text{i}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
